steps.en: Install the library into your Python environment
steps.zh: 把库装进 Python 环境

steps.en: Point it at an article URL and fetch the page
steps.zh: 指向一个文章 URL 并抓取页面

steps.en: Downloads the static HTML over requests and auto-detects the page language
steps.zh: 用 requests 下载静态 HTML，并自动检测页面语言

steps.en: Run the extraction in one call
Strips nav, ads and boilerplate, returns clean title, body text, authors, publish date and top image
steps.zh: 剥掉导航、广告和样板，返回干净的标题、正文、作者、发布日期和头图

value.en: One clean article record per URL — no per-site CSS/XPath rules to write or maintain
value.zh: 每个 URL 一条干净的文章记录——不用为每个站点写 CSS/XPath 规则，也不用养它们
